blocks.name: Tien Shinhan (green pants, red sash) - NPC ally fighter
blocks.notes: Cells are 32x32 on the checkerboard #47ffbb/#34bc88; the surround is #2a966c and empty cells carry a #237f5a border - treat all four as transparent. The baked ground shadow is #000000, the same colour as outlines/eyes (and hair where black), so strip it by geometry, never by colour. The RIGHT row is a pixel-exact horizontal mirror of the LEFT row in every column. Every frame of a body on the floor sits in a ko* animation, which the build strips in its 'flat' shadow mode so black hair and eye lines touching the floor survive. Tien is bald (no hair ramp) and has a third eye (white/#c6c6c6 with a black pupil). Row lengths: down 29 (0-28), left/right 34 (0-33), up 29 with up col 1 empty (no back-view blink). Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk (right step, pass, left step, pass), 6-9 punch string (6 fighting-stance wind-up, 7 straight jab with a white trail, 8 hook with a white arc, 9 follow-through with the arc's tail) - split into punch1 6-7 (wind-up, jab) and punch2 6, 8-9 (wind-up, hook, follow-through) so each string's second frame is its hit, 'combo' plays it whole; 10-13 kick string (10 knee chambered, 11 side kick with a white trail, 12 extended kick with the trail's tail, 13 knee retracted) - used as both punch3 and kick, like Goku's third string; 14-16 one-hand ki blast (14 wind-up stance, 15 front palm thrust, 16 rear palm thrust - loop 15-16 for rapid fire; facing up the thrusting arm points up the screen). 17-19 hurt/guard set: 18 hurt recoil (hunched, eyes shut, hit sparks); 17 and 19 are the same braced block pose with and without the white spark (spark on 17 for left/right, on 19 for down/up). 20 power-up stance (left/right identical to idle; down/up a pixel lower with the arms set wider) - the engine draws the aura on top. 21-24 level-up cheer like Goku's 42-45: 21 fists raised beside the head with sparkles, 22 wide-eyed with sparkles, 23 fists raised, 24 wide-eyed near-idle (also 'surprised'). 25-28 flying (no baked shadow): side rows horizontal Superman pose, down row head-first toward the camera with the shoes above the head, up row from behind with dangling legs. 29-32 (left/right only) knock-out: 29 hit with sparks, 30 recoil with sparks, 31 thrown onto his backside, 32 flat on his back (koHold). 33 (left/right only) 'blownAway': the body stretched out horizontally in the air with the head toward the back of the facing (left row: head on the right), hands by the head, legs straight, no ground shadow - reads as being launched backwards by a hit; its skin uses a yellow-tan ramp (skinAlt #ad7b39/#dead63/#f7c673, the ramp Yamcha and Hercule use) found nowhere else on Tien, so recolour skinAlt together with skin. Baked effects: white trails in 7-9 and 11-12, two-size white sparks in 17-19, 21-22, 29-30. Palette: outfit = green gi, outfit2 = red sash and wristbands, boots = black shoes (#424242/#5a5a5a/#737373 soles), wraps = olive ankle wraps; #737373 is also the eyes' mid-grey. Stray single pixels of #210084/#21217b/#7b3100 in a few action cells are ripper residue.
